title: IC14 in Adult Patients With Dengue Fever
brief_summary: Randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled, safety, PK/PD and preliminary efficacy study of intravenous IC14 in adult patients in a dengue-endemic region presenting with fever \> 38°C for \< 48 hours with a positive NS1 strip assay or reverse-transcriptase polymerase chain reaction assay for dengue virus.
